finalMessage:
The bug was in `roundCents` in `src/billing/round.js`. It used `Math.floor(amount * 100) / 100`, which always rounds down, so 1.236 became 1.23. I changed it to `Math.round(amount * 100) / 100`, which rounds to the nearest cent. `invoice.js` is the only caller, and `node check.js` now prints `ok`.

The `src/modules/m*.js` files also mention rounding, but their comments say they only handle display and don't round stored amounts, so I left them alone.

One caveat: `Math.round(amount * 100)` can still misround values that sit exactly on a half cent, because of binary floating-point error (for example, 1.005 may be stored slightly below 1.005). The check passes and the task didn't cover that case, so I didn't change it. If that matters for your invoices, I can switch to integer-cent arithmetic or a decimal library.
